_howto: Owner-editable announcement feed. The app fetches this fresh on every cold start (web + native) — edit, commit, push; NO Play rollout needed. Each message shows once per device (tracked by id). Fields: id (required, unique, never reuse), enabled (set true to go live), title, body (array of plain-text paragraphs — HTML is NOT rendered), cta_label + cta_url (optional button, https only), platforms (optional, any of: "android" and "ios" for the store apps, "web" for any browser, "web-apple" for a browser on an iPhone, iPad or Mac), minVersion/maxVersion (optional APP_VERSION range, e.g. only nudge old builds), starts/ends (optional ISO dates for a time window).

messages.title: Sample announcement
body: This is a sample message — flip "enabled" to true and push to show it to everyone.

messages._note: Turn on once the iPhone app is live on the App Store: paste its link into cta_url, set enabled to true, push.
messages.title: Duitful is on the App Store
body: On an iPhone or iPad, Duitful Pro backs up to your own iCloud by itself, encrypted so only your passcode opens it.
Moving over: Settings → Export CSV here, then Settings → Import CSV in the app.
